findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: commodity_edge, edge_alerts, best_available, adp_market_gaps · Private data: calculate_ev, combo_edge, find_arbitrage · Public sink: find_arbitrage, market_pulse, draft_board, best_available, sleepers_and_busts, who_do_i_draft, adp_market_gaps · Destructive: convert_probability, combo_edge, best_available, who_do_i_draft.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: commodity_edge, edge_alerts, best_available, adp_market_gaps · Private data: calculate_ev, combo_edge, find_arbitrage · Public sink: find_arbitrage, market_pulse, draft_board, best_available, sleepers_and_busts, who_do_i_draft, adp_market_gaps · Destructive: convert_probability, combo_edge, best_available, who_do_i_draft

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
